justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, typed error enum, and separate internal/public state enums with retry data on the variant; misses opportunities like a typed CheckoutError vs general QueueError or distinct error variants per operation.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with informative UnknownJob/NotRunning variants and Display impl; uses an assert! in new() and an unwrap() in checkout without documented reasoning.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public surface is reasonable with sensible derives, but there are no doc comments on any public item and QueueError lacks std::error::Error impl.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, derives, and pattern matching reasonably well, but the checkout loop awkwardly does a second HashMap lookup after iteration and clones the payload rather than structuring borrows more cleanly.
